top.title: Trump warns of new strikes against Iran after new year, calls negotiators ‘professional tap dancers’
top.rewrite: Trump warns of new strikes against Iran after new year, calls negotiators 'professional tap dancers'
top.summary: In exclusive comments to Fox News on Sunday, Trump said he is inclined to order strikes on Iran after the new year if no deal is reached, calling Iran's negotiators 'professional tap dancers' and the talks meaningless. He said Tehran has grown more aggressive since the US elections, while the US naval blockade of Iranian ports holds.

featured.title: Iran amasses 14 oil tankers at key export hub as Tehran weighs challenge to US blockade: report
featured.rewrite: Iran amasses 14 oil tankers at key export hub as Tehran weighs challenge to US blockade: report
featured.summary: More than 14 tankers have gathered at Iran's most important crude export terminal as Tehran tries to get oil flowing again despite the US naval blockade, according to a report cited by the Post. Experts quoted in the story doubted the claim.

featured.title: Senator hopes Jensen Huang enjoyed affair with suspected Chinese spy because 'it's the most expensive sex since Helen of Troy'
featured.rewrite: Senator hopes Jensen Huang enjoyed affair with suspected Chinese spy because 'it's the most expensive sex...
featured.summary: Louisiana Republican Sen. John Kennedy mocked former Nvidia boss Jensen Huang over his affair with a suspected Chinese spy, saying he hoped Huang had a good time because it was 'the most expensive sex since Helen of Troy.'

featured.title: NYC releases another massive trove of secret 9/11 health records: ‘Waited 25 years to see’
featured.rewrite: NYC releases another massive trove of secret 9/11 health records: 'Waited 25 years to see'
featured.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Sunday his office has released 84,000 more previously secret records on air quality and toxic health concerns after the Sept. 11, 2001 attacks on the World Trade Center.

featured.title: Trump on credit card interest rate cap: ‘I would do it’
featured.rewrite: Trump on credit card interest rate cap: 'I would do it'
featured.summary: Asked on Fox's 'Saturday in America' whether the one-year 10% cap on credit card interest rates he floated in January could be a deal with Democrats, Trump said 'I would do it.' Leading Democratic figures also back a cap.

left.summary: Sayed Mohassib, accused of killing Brooklyn jogger Katie Suarez, claims he was acting on divine orders and that Allah instructed him to kill a stranger.

left.rewrite: Schumer's opposition to 2018 Iran nuke deal weaponized in Senate leadership race
left.summary: Sen. Chris Van Hollen is using Schumer's past opposition to the Iran nuclear deal in his bid to replace the New York Democrat as Senate majority leader in the new Congress.

left.summary: House Democrats are pushing a $25 minimum wage as an answer to the affordability crisis. Heritage Foundation economist E.J. Antoni warned it could raise costs and unemployment.

center.summary: Katie Miller shared a cropped screenshot of Trump's April post threatening that 'a whole civilization will die tonight,' then deleted it; it is unclear why she posted it. The US and Israel are reportedly weighing more strikes as indirect talks with Iran stall.

center.summary: Trump is pressing European leaders to get Kyiv to agree terms with Putin by early in the new year, before he loses control of Congress, according to reports. He appeared to shrug off Russia's strikes on Poland, saying Putin had been 'landing drones in Poland, and a couple of little missiles, by mistake.'

center.rewrite: Russia open to 'NATO-like' status for Ukraine — but only if Putin can keep captured territory: US official
center.summary: A US official said Moscow has signalled it is 'OK' with Ukraine receiving protections similar to NATO's Articles 4 and 5, provided Russia keeps the territory it has captured. The aim would be to get Ukraine 'as close to NATO as possible without the brand.'

center.title: Seismic shift in latest Newspoll as voters turn against Anthony Albanese

center.summary: The Supreme Court ordered Prahran independent Tosh-Jake Finnigan not to hand out how-to-vote cards imitating the Greens' colours and font. Separately, the Liberals pledged to make Victoria's top prosecutor face annual questioning in parliament.

right.title: Russell Crowe’s Request to Shoot ‘A Beautiful Mind’ Chronologically Added $1 Million to the Budget, Says Ron Howard: ‘It Was the Right Kind of Investment’
right.rewrite: Russell Crowe's Request to Shoot 'A Beautiful Mind' Chronologically Added $1 Million to the Budget, Says...
right.summary: Ron Howard told People that shooting the 2001 film in sequence at Crowe's request cost the studio an extra $1 million, but called it 'the right kind of investment' given Crowe's performance as mathematician John Nash.

right.title: E.J. Carroll, ‘Law & Order,’ ‘GTA 5’ and ‘Blue Bloods’ Actor, Dies at 66
right.rewrite: E.J. Carroll, 'Law & Order,' 'GTA 5' and 'Blue Bloods' Actor, Dies at 66
right.summary: Carroll died suddenly on Thursday, his rep told Variety; no cause of death has been given. His nearly 30-year career included 'The Deuce,' 'Law & Order,' 'Grand Theft Auto V' and Darren Aronofsky's 'The Wrestler.'

right.title: CMA Awards See a 55% Ratings Bump in Key Adult Demo With Taylor Swift’s Return to the Show
right.rewrite: CMA Awards See a 55% Ratings Bump in Key Adult Demo With Taylor Swift's Return to the Show
right.summary: With Taylor Swift performing at the CMA Awards for the first time in 13 years, the 60th telecast was up 26% in total viewers and 55% among adults 18-49 on last year.

right.title: ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’ Begins Global Weekend With $76M Running Cume – Update
right.rewrite: 'Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping' Begins Global Weekend With $76M Running Cume – Update
right.summary: Lionsgate's sixth Hunger Games film reached about $76M worldwide, counting an expected $51M Friday with $21M in previews, already close to the $100.1M global start of 2023's 'The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes.'
